title: Kyiv: 12 killed
description: Update: 'It was a horror' — 12 killed in Kyiv and suburbs, including 6 rail workers, as Russia’s barrage enters 6th day. Russia continued its attacks on Kyiv for another consecutive night as air defenses in Ukraine's capital shot down Russian drones into Sept. 1, according to Kyiv Independent journalists on the ground.

title: Drone attack on residential area
description: The Russian Federation doubled the number of attacks by jet drones in just a month, but the Armed Forces have already found a solution to this, Flash. In July, Russia used about 1,500 jet drones, and in August - almost 3,000, said the adviser to the president on the development of technologies in the field of defense Sergey "Flash" Beskrestnov. At the same time, according to him, in the near future, the number of such attacks will probably remain approximately at the current level...

At the same time, according to him, in the near future, the number of such attacks will probably remain approximately at the current level...
description_uk: РФ удвоила количество атак реактивными дронами всего за месяц, но в ВСУ уже нашли этому решение, — Флеш В июле Россия применила около 1500 реактивных дронов, а в августе - уже почти 3000, сообщил советник президента по вопросам развития технологий в сфере обороны Сергей "Флеш" Бескрестнов. При этом, по его словам, в ближайшее время количество таких атак, вероятно, останется примерно на нынешнем...
